// diagnostic

E0441

This header only compares with `<>`, so it is the plain table `if {plain} {`

What

This header only compares with `<>`, so it is the plain table `if {plain} {`

Why

A plain `subject OP {` table compares each arm with its subject itself, and it keeps pattern and range arms and their coverage

Fix

Write `if {plain} {` without the `<>`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0441: Tests/UI/dispatch_hole_header_only_compares.stderr.

Error [jet.HoleHeaderOnlyCompares]: This header only compares with `<>`, so it is the plain table `if score >= {`
  --> Tests/UI/dispatch_hole_header_only_compares.jet:4:8
    |
  4 |     if score >= <> {
    |        ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A plain `subject OP {` table compares each arm with its subject itself, and it keeps pattern and range arms and their coverage
 Fix: Write `if score >= {` without the `<>`
